title: Saul's Death on Mount Gilboa
description: The Philistines defeat Israel on Mount Gilboa, and Saul's sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua fall in battle. Severely wounded, Saul asks his armor-bearer to kill him, but when he refuses, Saul throws himself on his own sword. The Philistines dishonor the body, but men from Jabesh in Gilead retrieve it and bury the bones.

versions.title: Saul's Death on Mount Gilboa
versions.description: King Saul and his sons fall in battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa. When Saul sees that all is lost, he throws himself on his own sword.
